protocols.purpose: Accession official DOJ SLS law-enforcement matter rows and linked documents without extracting person-level claims.
steps: Reopen the DOJ cases/matters page and record access time and page-updated label.
For each row, split state, matter label, source-page status label, agencies, and linked document labels.
Assign source-document IDs to each linked official document before summarizing it.
Classify document type: findings, complaint, consent decree, settlement agreement, monitor/compliance report, order, closing letter, technical assistance letter, statement of interest, other.
Record whether document is official DOJ, court-filed, monitor-issued, city/agency-issued, or other.
Preserve source-page status separately from current-status candidate.
Block person-level extraction by default.
protocols.rollback_trigger: DOJ page changes, linked document changes, court docket status contradicts source-page label, or document is withdrawn/corrected

protocols.purpose: Detect status drift in pattern-or-practice and consent-decree matters before public status display.
steps: Check SLS news page for recent press releases mentioning pilot agencies.
Classify each item as posture signal, legal filing signal, or court-order signal.
Never override a court order with a press release; use press release to open a status verification task.
Add watchlist rows for any agency where source-page label and news signal may diverge.
protocols.rollback_trigger: press release corrected, docket order found, source-page label updated

protocols.purpose: Provide agency-universe denominator and peer-context fields without using it as a misconduct source.
steps: Pin BJS publication and data collection pages.
Record collection year and inclusion/exclusion rules.
Never treat 2018 counts as current counts without a freshness warning.
Use only for denominator and agency-type context until newer official data is pinned.
protocols.rollback_trigger: new BJS CSLLEA release or errata

protocols.purpose: Model aggregate use-of-force collection limits and voluntary-participation caveats.
steps: Pin FBI data collection page and current CDE release when used.
Record voluntary participation and release-threshold caveats.
Do not infer specific incident legality, department policy compliance, or officer conduct from aggregate fields.
protocols.rollback_trigger: new FBI release, participation-status change, methodology update

protocols.purpose: Represent decertification-index existence and access limitations without creating officer records.
steps: Pin public IADLEST/NDI description pages.
Record that NDI is a registry of certificate/license revocation actions reported by participating state agencies.
Do not represent NDI as comprehensive or public officer-level access.
Defer any decertification pilot until state POST public records and NDI access model are separately mapped.
protocols.rollback_trigger: NDI access/policy change or state POST publication change

rev0005_addendum.rule: Before current-status claims, press-release status signals must pass through docket/order recheck and source-family comparison.
